responsibility: Provides rustc’s bundled ICU4X locale data as a compiled-in data source for the compiler. The crate root in `src/lib.rs` is the public entry point: it wraps the generated contents, re-exports the `BakedDataProvider`, offers construction of that provider, exposes the fixed list of bundled locales, and documents that this is the manually maintained shell around regenerated data. The `data` module contains the generated provider implementation itself: it defines the crate’s baked provider type and provider-installation wiring, including `AnyProvider` dispatch, and organizes the concrete datasets the provider serves. Within that generated namespace, the locale-fallback data supplies likely-subtags information, parent-locale exceptions, and collation-specific fallback supplements, while the list-formatting data supplies locale-specific conjunction patterns for formatting “and” lists. Together, these pieces make a single baked ICU data provider available to rustc so the compiler can use required internationalization and locale fallback/list-formatting data without depending on external runtime data files.
